processing_steps_notes.value: Binary Fe-Al alloys prepared by vacuum induction melting in Al2O3 crucibles using Fe of 99.99% purity (purified by zone melting to minimise impurity content) and Al of 99.999% purity. Applies to the polycrystalline Fe-16%Al alloy (nominal 16 at.% Al).

source.reason: Describes the melting route used to prepare all polycrystalline Fe-Al alloys including the nominal 16 at.% Al polycrystal that is the as-cast sample.

processing_steps_notes.value: Solidification in Cu moulds to obtain rods usually with 18 mm diameter. This is the terminal as-cast state of the sample; the as-cast polycrystalline alloys contained no second phases.

source.reason: Describes the solidification step producing the as-cast rods that define the sample's process state, and the resulting as-cast structure.
Describes the tensile specimen geometry and standard used for ductility testing.
